inline.headline: Every job, in the order it matters.
inline.text: Add the babyproofing list to Jib room by room, with the urgent fixes first and the rest set for the weeks before your baby crawls.
inline.alt: A dad kneeling beside a white chest of drawers in a nursery with one hand on top, checking where it meets the wall, while his baby chews a cloth toy on a play mat

jobs.title: Anchor the bookcase to the wall
jobs.description: Into a stud, not just the plasterboard. Heavy books on the bottom shelves.
directions: Find a stud behind the bookcase with a stud finder
Screw the wall bracket into the stud
Fix the strap to the top of the bookcase
Pull it snug and give it a firm tug

jobs.title: Tie the blind cords up 1.6m off the floor
Lock the medicines in the top cupboard

end.headline: Done before they crawl.
end.alt: A baby crawling across a jute rug towards his smiling dad, who is lying on his stomach on the living room floor

jobs.title: Fit a screwed-in gate at the top of the stairs
jobs.description: Hardware mounted, not pressure. One that opens with one hand.
directions: Find the studs or a solid post on each side
Screw the hinge and latch brackets in
Hang the gate so it can't swing out over the stairs
Check it latches every time you close it

jobs.title: Check the pool gate shuts and latches
Check every furniture anchor is still tight
